about: Definition of the 'feedback-off' comparison asked for in issue #33. EXTENSION, NOT SOURCE BEHAVIOR: GATE has no such switch. NOT IMPLEMENTED: the compiled solver cannot evaluate a given policy (see README.md, 'Feedback-off'). [[ai gen]] 2026-10-25.
definition: Simulate GATE's laws of motion with the planner's allocation replaced by constant shares: every year, output is split among consumption, capital, compute, hardware R&D and software R&D in the step-0 shares of the default run below, and compute between training and runtime in the step-0 split. Automation, R&D and output then evolve as in GATE, but rising output no longer changes how it is allocated. Compare the result with the optimized run on the six conclusions in RESULTS.md.
why_step_0: Step 0 is the first allocation the planner chooses, before automation has moved (f = f_init through step 2). Freezing it removes the planner's response to growth while keeping its initial judgement; freezing at observed 2025 shares (I_Q(0)/Y(0) = 0.0018) would be a different, larger change and is listed as an alternative.
shares_note: Rounded to 4 decimals from the default preset at each cap (variants/summary.json holds q_compute at full precision). q_capital at step 0 is itself optimizer noise (0.0013 / 0.0009 / 0.0002), so a feedback-off run should be done at all three cap values.
alternatives: shares frozen at observed initial values (compute I_Q(0)/Y(0), hardware and software R&D inputs over Y(0)), capital at the share that holds K/Y constant
shares frozen at their mean over steps 0-20 of the optimized run
requires: A simulator of GATE's laws of motion that takes a policy as input. The compiled solver exports only runSimulation (optimizes the policy itself), runSimulationChecks, getSimulationRunData and the beliefs helpers. gate_core.py does not reproduce E5, the R&D growth part of E6, or E10-E13 (EQUATIONS.md), so it cannot simulate either. Options: Epoch publishes the source or a policy-evaluation entry point; or an independent simulator closes those equations and is first checked against the official optimized runs by feeding it their own q paths.
